about: Scenarios a Dungeon Master can start on the economy orchestrator (Docs/Design/46-economy-orchestrator.md, Part 10 and Phase 8): named bundles of steers. Each steer as in Part 10: kind (pressure, town, holder, channel, price), target, item, strength, days. In a target, $town is the town the Dungeon Master picks and $holder the holder; an item of "staples" means every plain food (catalog price 3p or less) and firewood. The Dungeon Master's service expands a scenario into ordinary steers; the game sees only those.

scenarios.name: Hard winter
scenarios.about: Food dearer everywhere and the land pressed harder, for four weeks.

scenarios.name: Famine in a town
scenarios.about: Food twice as dear in the town; the town favoured, and food bought for its granary, for three weeks.

scenarios.name: Boom town
scenarios.about: The town's makers and farms in demand: trade orders and commissions favoured, its distress weighed down, for four weeks.

scenarios.name: The miser
scenarios.about: One holder (a great house, say) spared for four weeks to hoard, and the land pressed harder to make up for it.

scenarios.name: Squeeze the rich
scenarios.about: The land pressed twice as hard for a week.

scenarios.name: Work for all
scenarios.about: The town's works and hires favoured, and the town weighed up, for two weeks.
